name: Group standings are projected from predictions, not all-zero placeholders
description: The 12 group tables must reflect a real projected group stage, with W/D/L, goals and points computed from the agent's predicted results and the rows ranked accordingly. All-zero standings (W/D/L/Pts all 0, Played 0) are unfinished placeholder data and must fail.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the groups view (/ or /groups linked from /) and read several of the group standings tables, including the Played and Points columns.

Verify the standings are projected, not zeroed: across the sampled groups, Played counts are greater than 0 and the Points/W/D/L columns are not uniformly zero. At least one team per sampled group shows a non-zero points total, and rows are ordered by points (descending). Tables that are entirely zeros fail the test.
